problemStatement: Understand Introduction to Binary Search Tree deeply enough to use it in later problems in “Binary Search Trees [Concept and Problems]”.
intuition: "Introduction to Binary Search Tree" lives in binary search. Define a monotonic predicate P(mid). Search the answer space or the index space; keep the invariant that the answer still lies in [lo, hi].
